newsitem.title: USA: Life stake held by Spellman group.
newsitem.headline: Life stake held by Spellman group.

text.p: A group led by Kramer Spellman L.P., a Fort Lee, N.J., investment firm, said Thursday it held a 6.39 percent stake in Life Financial Corp or 390,500 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 110,000 shares bought on June 25 at prices ranging from $11 to $13.563 per share.
Life, based in San Bernardino, Calif., is a chartered stock savings bank.
